caption:
Figure 2: Workflow of OHM. Given a structured visual representation and a task-specific question,
the orchestration agent routes the input to perception agents that recover entities and relations. The
validation module examines the recovered graph with support from the ontology, after which task-
specific reasoning agents produce the final answer.
delegated_acceptance_review: Viewed final full export, read caption and eight paired-image checks. Preserved Input/Perception/Validation/Reasoning blocks, orchestration feedback and dynamic ontology, all example images and original unusual ontology chains. Four headings merely name existing stages; two extra sentences are directly from caption. Kept original graph semantics without correcting chain content or adding missing workflow edges. Whole scientific region independently replayed.
